If you use #AI screeners for your position, you should know three things about me. 

One, I now do not want your position. You've said all I need to hear about how much you value my time.

Two, I am however 100% petty enough to become Your Problem, and I will fuck with the AI 'recruiter' as much as possible.

Three, I work in #devops. A ton of my work is figuring out how diverse systems interact with each other. I am more than ready to apply those skills to wasting as much of your time as I can.
